principle: Frozen corpus ranks remain unchanged; v2 changes pedagogical burden, not corpus priority.

mastery.meaning: Recall without gloss; actively retrieved and checkpointed.
mastery.initialSource: Selected Core 1-200 items at original lesson context.

recognition.meaning: Recognize or infer in context; lower drill burden; may later promote through spaced retrieval.
recognition.source: Core 1-200 overflow plus high-priority Core 201-350 items at their existing pedagogical placement.

support.meaning: Tap/gloss support permitted; not treated as memorized vocabulary.
support.source: Remaining frozen-core candidates plus each lesson passiveReadingLexicon.

safeguards: No frozen rank file is rewritten.
No lesson introduces more than 8 new Tier-A mastery lemmas.
Tier-B recognition does not count as mastery merely because it appeared in a passage.
Tier-C support remains visible to the learner and support use may later feed mastery diagnostics.
A later corpus audit may promote additional Tier-B items; promotions require retrieval evidence and do not alter frozen rank.
